ॐ श्री गणेशाय नमः

GANAPATI

The Beginning of Everything

Maa Parvati

From love, life.

The promise

No one shall pass.

Shiva returns

The mountains tremble.

One moment

Then, silence.

Maa Shakti

A mother's grief. A universe aflame.

Into the forest

A life. A new beginning.

Ganapati

The first prayer. Forever.

Wisdom

The universe begins at home.

Bappa comes home

गणपति बप्पा मोरया!

He never leaves

पुढच्या वर्षी लवकर या

गणपति बप्पा मोरया
